name: Openobserve
description: Cloud-native observability platform for logs, metrics, traces, RUM, errors and session replays — a 140x cheaper alternative to Elasticsearch, Splunk and Datadog.
composeYaml:
services:
  openobserve:
    image: 'public.ecr.aws/zinclabs/openobserve:v0.90.0'
    environment:
      - ZO_DATA_DIR=/data
      - 'ZO_ROOT_USER_EMAIL=${ZO_ROOT_USER_EMAIL:-root@example.com}'
      - 'ZO_ROOT_USER_PASSWORD=${OPENOBSERVE_PASSWORD}'
      - 'ZO_TELEMETRY=${ZO_TELEMETRY:-false}'
      - 'ZO_COOKIE_SECURE_ONLY=${ZO_COOKIE_SECURE_ONLY:-true}'
    volumes:
      - 'openobserve-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /openobserve
        - node
        - status
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 60s
